name: compassion-benchmark
description: The Compassion Benchmark toolkit: a practice skill and read-only reviewer for behaving more compassionately (compassionate-practice, compassion-steward), plus a skill that drives a full self-scored run against the published benchmark using the separately-installed cb-probe MCP server (run-compassion-benchmark). Bundles no code and adds no capability beyond these three files -- see README.md for the MCP server's own install line, which this plugin cannot declare in its own manifest (see 'Why mcpServers is not declared' below).
